chunks: And Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who, at the time of his death, made a bequest of wealth to his relatives and freed a slave, and the total of all that he bequeathed exceeded one-third, how should his will be handled?
So he عليه السلام said: "The manumission is begun with first, and it is carried out."

key_terms.الْعِتْقِ: manumission or emancipation of a slave
key_terms.عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ: at the time of his death

ai.seo_question: If a dying person bequeaths more than one-third of his estate, including freeing a slave, which part of the will is carried out first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about competing bequests made at death when the total exceeds the one-third limit. It states that the emancipation of the slave takes priority and is executed first. The narration is significant in fiqh for the ordering of testamentary dispositions.
